checks.quote: Adobe Commerce REST APIs support multiple authentication methods, including: Third-party applications authenticate with OAuth 1.0a. Mobile applications authenticate using tokens. Administrators and customers are authenticated with login credentials.
In a production environment, you would typically create an integration and use OAuth to provide authentication for any REST call that requires admin privileges.
